How are you playing VRChat? I have a Quest 3S and use virtual desktop to play the SteamVR version of VRChat, and occasionally I plug in my xbox one controller and jokingly run around telling people I'm desktop walking. I think VRChat has to be the active desktop task for the joystick to work. 

Gaze and right trigger are your friends there. 

I haven't tried everything in that mode, so there might be some stuff missing.

details:
Hi VRChat Team,

I’m writing this not just as a VRChat user, but as someone who has always loved technology, creativity, and the possibilities of virtual worlds — especially when real-world limitations make those hard to access.

I have Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), which means I can't use VR motion controllers like most people. But I can use a game controller comfortably — and I love sitting in VRChat, exploring worlds, listening to music, and connecting with people. It gives me a sense of freedom that real life sometimes doesn’t.

That’s why I’m incredibly frustrated that I can’t use my game controller in VR mode, even though it works perfectly in desktop mode. The environments are the same. The mechanics are the same. The only real difference is that in VR, I’m forced to use motion controllers — which I physically cannot use.

🎯 My Request Is Simple:

Please let us use regular game controllers in VR mode — the same way we can in desktop mode.

Let us keep the headset for immersion and use a controller for movement, menus, and interactions.

That’s all. Just a toggle, or an experimental mode — anything.

This isn’t just about convenience. It’s about accessibility, autonomy, and being able to fully experience the virtual world in a way that works for people like me.

VRChat means a lot to me — but sometimes it hurts to feel like I’m not meant to be part of it just because I can’t wave my arms around like everyone else.

Thank you so much for reading this. I know accessibility isn’t always easy to implement, but this change could open doors for a lot of people. I’d be grateful to test or offer input if it helps.

Thank you.
title: Accessibility Request: Allow Controller Use in VR Mode
